metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Claims Center" "C4 model of the insurance claims platform" {

    model {

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform for reporting and tracking claims, owned and operated by the insurance company" {

            webPortal = container "Web portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress" "HTML/JavaScript"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile app backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app" "REST API"
            claimsIntake = container "Claims intake service" "Registers new claims" "REST API"
            triage = container "Triage service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims" "REST API"
            assessment = container "Assessment service" "Calculates settlement amounts" "REST API"
            payout = container "Payout service" "Executes claim settlements" "REST API"
            fraudScreening = container "Fraud screening service" "Flags suspicious claims" "REST API"
            documentService = container "Document service" "Accepts claim photos and reports" "REST API"
            notification = container "Notification service" "Emails and messages policyholders" "REST API"
            assignment = container "Assignment service" "Routes claims to adjusters" "REST API"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims" "HTML/JavaScript"
            policyVerification = container "Policy verification service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy" "REST API"
            reinsuranceAllocation = container "Reinsurance allocation service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners" "REST API"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation" "scheduled job"
            eventQueue = container "Event queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts" "message queue"
            claimsDatabase = container "Claims database" "Stores claim records" "SQL database"
            policyDatabase = container "Policy database" "Stores policy and cover records" "SQL database"
            auditDatabase = container "Audit database" "Stores the compliance audit trail" "SQL database"
            documentStore = container "Document store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence" "object store"
        }

        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Reports claims and tracks their progress"
        adjuster = person "Adjuster" "Staff member who processes assigned claims"

        claimsDataBureau = softwareSystem "National claims data bureau" "Operated by a different organization"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing house" "Operated by a different organization"

        policyholder -> webPortal "reports claims and tracks their progress" "HTTPS"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks their progress via the mobile app" "HTTPS"
        adjuster -> adjusterWorkbench "processes assigned claims" "HTTPS"

        webPortal -> claimsIntake "uses" "REST"
        webPortal -> assessment "uses" "REST"
        webPortal -> payout "uses" "REST"
        webPortal -> documentService "uses" "REST"
        webPortal -> notification "uses" "REST"

        mobileAppBackend -> claimsIntake "uses" "REST"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessment "uses" "REST"
        mobileAppBackend -> payout "uses" "REST"
        mobileAppBackend -> documentService "uses" "REST"
        mobileAppBackend -> notification "uses" "REST"

        claimsIntake -> triage "hands accepted claims to" "REST"
        triage -> assessment "routes claims to" "REST"
        assessment -> payout "requests settlements from" "REST"

        claimsIntake -> fraudScreening "sends each incoming claim for screening" "REST"
        claimsIntake -> policyVerification "requests cover checks for each incoming claim" "REST"
        assignment -> adjusterWorkbench "routes claims to" "REST"

        fraudScreening -> claimsDataBureau "consults" "REST"
        payout -> clearingHouse "executes settlements through" "REST"

        documentService -> documentStore "reads from" "object store API"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDatabase "reads and writes" "SQL"
        batchScheduler -> policyDatabase "reads and writes" "SQL"
        notification -> policyholder "reports claim status changes" "email/SMS"

        claimsIntake -> eventQueue "publishes new claim events" "events"
        payout -> reinsuranceAllocation "apportions large losses" "REST"
        payout -> auditDatabase "records settlement audit trail" "SQL"
    }

    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" "System context diagram of the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }
        container claimsCenter "Containers" "Container diagram of the Claims Center" {
            include *
            autoLayout
        }
    }

    configuration {
        scope "SoftwareSystem"
    }
}
